condition: dayjs.tz.guess() can return an offset string like '+00:00' instead of an IANA zone name such as 'UTC'. This happens when Intl.DateTimeFormat().resolvedOptions().timeZone reports an offset in some Chrome or macOS environments.
workaround: Check the result of tz.guess(). If it is an offset string rather than an IANA name, replace it with a fallback such as 'UTC'.
